Build2 is compiling the backend (clang is now working). Let's wait for the build to complete and check the Traefik routing on port 3000.

action.command: echo "=== Traefik-routed services (port 3000) ==="; for h in auth.localhost pgadmin.localhost valhalla.localhost streamlet.localhost; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 10 -H "Host: $h" http://localhost:3000/ 2>&1); echo "$h -> $code"; done; echo "=== keycloak health ==="; curl -s -m 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready -H "Host: auth.localhost" 2>&1 | head -c 200
